recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Shared types and foundation modules
recommended_phases.rationale: Establish the shared-types module (LeaveType, LeaveStatus enums) and the employee module — these have zero internal dependencies and are required by everything else. Also set up the audit module since it's a cross-cutting concern mandated by GP-002.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Policy and balance domain modules
recommended_phases.rationale: Build policy (leave rules, max days per type) and balance (per-employee leave balances, deduct/restore). Both depend only on shared-types; policy is also a dependency of balance. These are the core domain logic modules.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Leave application module
recommended_phases.rationale: Build the leave module — the orchestrator that wires employee, policy, balance, audit, and notification together. This is the largest module: models, repository, service, controller, and routes. Depends on all prior phases.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4: Notification module and integration wiring
recommended_phases.rationale: Build the notification module (email/in-app notifications for leave events). Wire up the Fastify plugin registration, RBAC guards on routes, and end-to-end integration tests.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: shared-types (innermost, pure enums/DTOs with no behavior) → domain modules (employee, policy, balance — own their models, repository interfaces, and service interfaces) → application module (leave — orchestrates domain modules, owns controller and routes) → cross-cutting (audit, notification — called by leave but independent). Dependencies flow strictly inward: leave depends on all inner modules; balance depends on policy and shared-types; policy and employee depend only on shared-types; audit and notification are standalone. No circular dependencies. Every public service method is declared in an interface before implementation. LeaveType and LeaveStatus enums are placed in src/shared/types/ because they are pure value types used by multiple modules. All state-changing operations in LeaveService must call IAuditService.record() per GP-002. All route handlers must enforce RBAC per GP-005. All inputs validated at API boundaries per GP-003.
